armor.name: Obsidian Warlord
armor.desc: Spiked pauldrons, a crest and a dark cape. Violet wisps rise off you.

armor.name: Gilded Sovereign
armor.desc: A crown, gold shoulder plates and a royal cape. Sparkles follow you.

armor.name: Frostbound
armor.desc: Ice shards on your shoulders and a floating crystal. Snow drifts around you.

armor.name: Bloodmoon Fiend
armor.desc: Curved horns and a tattered red cape. Embers rise off you.

armor.name: Verdant Warden
armor.desc: Antlers and leafy shoulders. Leaves fall behind you.

armor.name: Bonelord
armor.desc: Skull pauldrons and a floating bone crown. Green soul-fire flickers around you.

wings.name: Seraph wings
wings.desc: White feathered wings and a golden halo.

wings.name: Phoenix wings
wings.desc: Wings of living flame that shed embers.

wings.name: Void shards
wings.desc: Floating shards of the rift that drift apart and back.

wings.name: Rime wings
wings.desc: Angular wings of ice that shed snow.

weapon.name: Emberforged
weapon.desc: A burning blade, a flaming bow or a staff topped with fire.

weapon.name: Glacial
weapon.desc: A long crystal blade, an ice bow or a staff crowned with a crystal.

weapon.name: Voidreaper
weapon.desc: A scythe, a bow with an orbiting rift-spark or a staff holding a void orb.

weapon.name: Royal
weapon.desc: A broad golden cleaver with a crossguard, a gilded bow or a crowned staff.

weapon.name: Ossuary
weapon.desc: A bone club, a spiked bone bow or a skull staff.

petSkin.name: Golden
petSkin.desc: Gold all over, wearing a tiny crown. Sparkles.

petSkin.name: Shadow
petSkin.desc: Pitch black with glowing eyes, trailing smoke.

petSkin.name: Frost
petSkin.desc: Icy, with a ring of ice spikes. Snowflakes fall off it.

petSkin.name: Infernal
petSkin.desc: Little horns and a burning glow.

petSkin.name: Spectral
petSkin.desc: A see-through ghost that floats and leaves wisps.
